# /craft:ci:triage

> **Triage a failing CI check: classify as diff-caused vs pre-existing/infra and recommend re-run / --admin / fix with evidence**

---

## Synopsis

```bash
/craft:ci:triage [arguments]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pr` | no | — | PR number or URL (default = the current branch's open PR) |
| `repo` | no | — | Repo in OWNER/NAME form (default = Data-Wise/craft) |
| `json` | no | false | Output structured JSON instead of the verdict box |
